Proactive Voice: MARK shouldn't just wait for you. It should speak up when needed. "Sir, your RAM usage is at 98%, should I close some Chrome tabs for you?" or "You have a meeting in 5 minutes, would you like me to open the Zoom link?"
Aura Window Management: Advanced voice-controlled snapping. "Tile Safari and VS Code side-by-side" or "Focus my terminal and dim everything else."

Web Steering (Actual Browser Navigation)
Beyond just opening URLs, MARK uses a "headless" or automated browser to act on your behalf.

Booking: "Mark, find me a table for two at a top-rated Italian place for 8 PM tonight."
Research: "Look up the stock price of Tesla, find a recent news article explaining its movement, and summarize it for me."
Presence Detection: MARK dims your screen when you walk away and "wakes up" (orb glows) the moment you sit down.

Spatial UI (Camera-Based Shortcuts)
Using the camera for more than just "seeing" your screen.

Air Gestures:
Finger to lips = Mute all system audio.
Point at a window = Bring it to front.
Two fingers up = Increase brightness.

Holographic HUD (Heads-Up Display)
Concept: A sci-fi glassmorphism overlay that appears only when needed.
Interaction: When you ask "What's my schedule?", a transparent glass card slides in from the right edge, shows your calendar, and then fades out. No opening "apps" or "browser tabs." It feels like Iron Man's JARVIS interface.
Tech: We can build this using an Electron transparent window or a specialized web overlay.

Automated File Organization ("The Digital Janitor")
Concept: MARK keeps your desktop clean so you don't have to.
Action: "MARK, clean up my desktop."
Logic:
Moves screenshots to ~/Pictures/Screenshots/YYYY-MM.
Moves PDFs to ~/Documents/Papers.
Deletes .dmg and .zip files older than 7 days.
Addictive Factor: Seeing a messy desktop vanish in seconds is incredibly satisfying.

Voice-Powered Coding Assistant (The "Copilot" Voice)
Concept: Dictate code or refactors.
Action: "MARK, create a Python script to scrape Reddit for 'AI News' and save it to a CSV."
Result: MARK writes the file, installs dependencies (pip install praw), and runs it—all hands-free.

Autonomous "Research Agent" (Deep Dive)
Concept: Give MARK a topic, and he writes a full report.
Action: "MARK, prepare a briefing on 'Quantum Computing in 2024'."
Result: MARK browses 10 websites, summarizes key points, finds relevant images/charts, and saves a formatted Quantum_Report.md to your desktop.

Voice-Controlled "Photoshop" (Image Manipulation)
Concept: Basic image editing with words.
Action: "MARK, take screenshot.png, crop it to square, add a 'CONFIDENTIAL' watermark in red text, and save it as final.png."
Tech: Pillow (PIL) library makes this easy and fast.
